name: sn-bose-sync-up
description: Team Finder is a the solution to a problem faced by many developers i.e. finding team based on their expertise. It is a platform which helps developers connect to an existing team project as well as make their own team.
author: Piyush Chatterjee, Hrishikesh Sharma, Rohan Majumder, Bhargav Jyoti Nath
